raw_text: Read core instructions first from remote `main`; follow required/needed links. Use RAW URLs only. Agents MUST resolve dynamic workflows from the remote canonical repository. Do not use local mirrors. Agents MUST resolve workflow assignments (by shortId) from the remote canonical repository. Do not use local mirrors. Don't assume your shell is bash. Its probably pwsh. Detect what type of shell you have before running any commands. Your web-fetch tool is disabled. Use powershell or curl to fetch files from the web. Orchestrator agents MUST delegate technical work to specialist agents. Minimum 75% delegation coverage required. Use MCP GitHub tools first, then VS Code integration, and only fall back to terminal gh as a last resort.
